title: Mean bound for a nonconstant junta
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, and let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ depend on at most $k$ coordinates and be nonconstant. For the uniform mean $\mathbb E f=2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{-1,1\}^n}f(x)$, one has $|\mathbb E f|\leq 1-2^{-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean sign-valued function on the $n$-cube
$f$ depends on some set of at most $k$ coordinates
